title: MPS Calculator: three edge rules for deal-usage proposals (one tap settles all three)
bluf: I need your ruling on three edge cases the gate found on deal-usage quotes. No screen creates such a quote yet, so no customer sees them today. (1) The one-pager repeats the same mono and colour pair per device class and its six-rate cap hides rows with four or more classes (MPSCALC-228): recommended, one combined pair per deal. (2) A colour rate prints for a class with no colour pages (MPSCALC-229): recommended, print a colour rate only for classes with estimated colour pages. (3) A deal whose only device is optional calculates and prints a proposal with no rates (MPSCALC-230): recommended, block it like the empty-quote rule. Each is a customer-document change.
